tagline: ISP ke andar poore address lookup ki jagah chhote labels.
description: Bahut se ISP networks ke andar packets ko unke IP address se hop by hop route nahi kiya jaata. Pehla router samne ek chhota label laga deta hai, core routers sirf labels swap karte hain, aur exit ke paas label hata diya jaata hai. Isi trick se ek ISP hazaaron private company networks (VPNs) ko saath saath carry kar leta hai.

normal.name: Push, swap, pop
normal.summary: Customer ka packet ISP core ko PE1 se PE2 tak ek label-switched path par cross karta hai.

steps.title: Plain IP aata hai
steps.desc: PE1 ko ek aam packet milta hai
steps.detail: Customer ka 203.0.113.10 ka connection PE1 par aata hai, jo provider edge router hai. PE1 ek normal IP lookup karta hai aur dekhta hai ki exit PE2 hai. Pehle LDP (Label Distribution Protocol) ne PE1 ko bataya tha ki P1 PE2 ki taraf jaane wali har cheez ke liye label 24001 chahta hai.

steps.title: Label push karo
steps.detail: PE1 Ethernet header aur IP header ke beech 4-byte label entry daalta hai aur EtherType 0x8847 set karta hai. Label ka TTL IP TTL se copy hota hai, uske ghatne ke baad (63), isliye traceroute ko ab bhi har hop dikhta hai. S bit 1 hai kyunki yeh akela, yaani bottom, label hai.

quiz.q: Agla router kaise jaanta hai ki Ethernet header ke baad MPLS label hai, IP nahi?
options: Woh size se andaza lagata hai
quiz.why: Ethernet Type field batata hai ki aage kya aa raha hai: IPv4 ke liye 0x0800, MPLS label stack ke liye 0x8847.

steps.title: Core mein swap
steps.desc: P1 24001 ko 24017 se swap karta hai
steps.detail: P1 24001 ko ek chhoti label table mein dhoondta hai, poori internet routing table mein nahi. Table kehti hai: ise 24017 se replace karo aur P2 ko bhejo. P1 label TTL ko 62 karta hai aur IP header ko padhta hi nahi.

quiz.q: Andar ke IP header mein ab bhi TTL 63 hai. P1 ne use kam kyun nahi kiya?
options: P1 sirf top label padhta aur update karta hai
IP TTL sirf server par badalta hai
Labels mein TTL hota hi nahi
quiz.why: Core routers sirf top label par kaam karte hain: woh label ka TTL ghatate hain aur IP header ko haath nahi lagate. IP TTL tab theek hota hai jab label hataya jaata hai.

steps.title: Ek hop pehle pop
steps.detail: PE2 ne P2 se kaha ki label 3 use karo, “implicit null”. Yeh label kabhi bheja nahi jaata: iska matlab hai “mujhe dene se pehle label hata do”. Isliye P2, jo second-to-last router hai, label pop karta hai aur uska TTL minus one (61) IP header mein copy kar deta hai. PE2 ko plain IP milta hai.

quiz.q: Label PE2 ki jagah P2 se kyun hatwaya jaata hai?
options: Labels last router tak pahunch hi nahi sakte
PE2 ko tab label lookup aur phir IP lookup ki jagah sirf ek IP lookup karna padta hai
Customer se label chhupane ke liye
quiz.why: Agar label PE2 tak aata, to woh label lookup karke sirf yeh dekhta ki “ise hata do”, phir IP lookup karta. Ek hop pehle pop karne se PE2 ka yeh extra step bach jaata hai.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.desc: PE2 packet ko normally route karta hai
steps.detail: PE2 aam IP lookup karta hai aur packet server ko bhejta hai, IP TTL ko 60 karke. Server ko normal packet dikhta hai aur use pata bhi nahi chalta ki labels kabhi use hue the.

outro.title: Labels par core paar
outro.text: PE1 ne ek IP lookup kiya aur label push kiya, P1 ne use swap kiya, P2 ne pop kiya, aur PE2 ne plain IP packet deliver kiya. Core routers ne sirf 4-byte label dekha.

l3vpn.name: Do labels: company VPN
l3vpn.summary: ISP ek shop chain ka private 10.x network Pune aur Delhi ke beech transport label aur VPN label se carry karta hai.

steps.title: Customer ke VRF mein
steps.desc: PE1 har customer ke liye alag table rakhta hai
steps.detail: Shop ka Pune office Delhi mein 10.2.2.10 ko packet bhejta hai. Doosre customers bhi 10.x addresses use karte hain, isliye PE1 har customer ke liye alag routing table, yaani VRF, rakhta hai. Is shop ke VRF mein PE2 ne 10.2.2.0/24 ko MP-BGP par VPN label 18 ke saath advertise kiya hai.

quiz.q: Do alag customers dono 10.2.2.10 use karte hain. PE2 ko kaise pata chalta hai ki packet kiska hai?
options: Nahi pata chalta, isliye addresses unique hone chahiye
quiz.why: PE2 har customer ke routes ko apna VPN label deta hai. Label 18 wala packet aane par PE2 jaan jaata hai ki woh SHOP-A ki table ka hai.

steps.title: Do labels push karo
steps.desc: Upar transport label, neeche VPN label
steps.detail: PE1 do labels push karta hai. Andar wala, 18, batata hai ki kaun sa customer. Bahar wala, 24001, wahi transport label hai jo PE2 jaane wala koi bhi traffic use karta hai. Sirf andar wale par S (bottom of stack) bit set hota hai.

steps.title: Core sirf top dekhta hai
steps.detail: P1 ise bilkul pehle wale plain packet ki tarah handle karta hai. Woh top label swap karta hai aur label 18 ko chhuta bhi nahi. P routers ko VPNs ka pata hi nahi hota aur unke paas koi customer routes nahi hote, isi wajah se yeh design hazaaron customers tak scale karta hai.

quiz.q: P2 ke penultimate hop popping ke baad PE2 ko kya milta hai?
options: Kuch nahi: P2 use drop kar deta hai
quiz.why: P2 sirf transport label pop karta hai. VPN label bacha rehta hai, aur PE2 ko sahi customer table chunne ke liye uski zaroorat hoti hai.

steps.title: Transport label pop hua
steps.detail: Pehle ki tarah P2 transport label pop karta hai kyunki PE2 ne implicit null maanga tha. VPN label 18 ab top aur akela label hai, S = 1 ke saath.

steps.title: VPN label table chunta hai
steps.desc: PE2 18 pop karke SHOP-A mein route karta hai
steps.detail: PE2 label 18 dhoondta hai, jo SHOP-A VRF ki taraf point karta hai. Woh label pop karta hai, us customer ki table mein 10.2.2.10 dhoondta hai aur packet Delhi office ko bhej deta hai. Shop ko yeh ek hi private network jaisa lagta hai.

outro.title: Shared core par private network
outro.text: Do labels kaam baant lete hain: bahar wala label packet ko core paar karata hai, andar wala label exit router ko batata hai ki woh kis customer ka hai. Isi tarah MPLS L3VPNs (RFC 4364) ISPs ko ek backbone par bahut si companies ko private networks bechne dete hain.
